title: KCP relation_assert request (DESIGN.md §10.2, §10.3, §11.6.1 space/content mutation + worker families)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Asserts a semantic SpaceRelation over exact visible endpoint revisions in the same space (§10.2): the public/worker schema excludes relation_class and always creates semantic_assertion (§10.2 spelled; gap note KG23). Relation appends present the branch and expected head digest (§10.3; gap note KG20). Dual-surface operation: one schema pair serves both registry entries (byom G35 pattern; gap note KG14). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / principal (assurance: current login) | surface worker / invocation attempt only (assurance: workload identity plus invocation capability). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

branch_id.description: The branch appended to (§10.3 branch key; recorded as origin_branch_id — gap note KG20).

expected_head_digest.description: The §10.3 expected branch head digest for compare-and-swap (gap note KG20).

schema_ref.description: Relation payload schema (§10.2); server-defaulted when omitted (gap note KG21 pattern).

attempt_id.description: Worker-surface binding: every worker operation carries {attempt_id, fence_epoch} (§15.2). Required together with fence_epoch on the worker surface, forbidden on external_client — a (operation, surface) registry rule the shared schema cannot express (gap note KG14).

args.description: Branch-append pin (gap note KG20) plus the caller-suppliable §10.2 SpaceRelation fields (gap note KG23). No relation_class member exists: an external caller cannot request, spoof, or upgrade a structural relation (§10.2 spelled).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

objectRefTriple.description: Exact endpoint pin {object_ref, revision, digest} (§10.2 SpaceRelation from_ref/to_ref; exact object refs always include the applicable revision and canonical digest, §10 preamble).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

relationKind.description: Closed RelationKind enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed). A relation confers no visibility, admission, truth, trust, acceptance, scheduling, execution, or permission (§10.2).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
